scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run migrate
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:rebuild: npm run build && pm2 reload ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
